result.summary: The image shows a high-density urban intersection with wide sidewalks and high-visibility continental crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance without intermediate refuge.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Potential for high-speed turning movements
hazards.description: The wide radius of the intersection and multiple lanes may encourage faster vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. While the infrastructure is well-maintained with wide sidewalks and clear lane markings, the multi-lane crossing distance increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic, including a dedicated bus lane, which increases their time of exposure in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: The main crosswalk spanning the width of the street in the foreground.

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflicts
hazards.description: The wide intersection geometry allows for higher-speed vehicle turns that may conflict with pedestrians who have the right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners where vehicles turn across the pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with wide sidewalks and basic pedestrian infrastructure. While crosswalks and signals are present, the markings are significantly faded, and the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions may impact safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade faded markings to high-visibility continental patterns to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.
